questions: Have you had progressive weakness in your arms and legs for more than 6 months?
Do you have difficulty climbing stairs or getting up from the floor?
Have you noticed your muscles getting visibly thinner over time?
Does anyone in your family have similar muscle weakness or wasting?
Have you noticed any abnormal twisting or stiff postures in your hands, feet, or neck?
Did your symptoms start in childhood or adolescence?
Have you ever had involuntary movements, tremors, or jerky movements?
Are your symptoms worse on one side of the body?
Are your symptoms worse at a particular time of day (e.g., evening)?
Does levodopa (a trial of levodopa/carbidopa) improve your symptoms?
Has a trial of levodopa ever been tried?
Do you experience slowness of movement in addition to stiffness?
Have you had any skeletal abnormalities (e.g., short stature, hip dysplasia, or spine issues)?
Have you ever had corneal clouding or a heart murmur?
Have you had any developmental delay or cognitive impairment?
orders: Neurological examination focusing on gait, coordination, and muscle tone
Therapeutic trial of levodopa/carbidopa (e.g., 100/25 mg TDS for 4 weeks)
MRI brain with focus on basal ganglia
Leukocyte or fibroblast beta-galactosidase enzyme assay
